note: Hand-kept: web addresses that are gone in a way the fetchers' own checks can't see (helper.check_websites catches a missing domain and a 404 or 410 by itself). Here: addresses with an invalid domain, pages that redirect somewhere unrelated, and news headlines whose page has been taken down. A fetcher treats these as dead and links a Wayback Machine copy where there is one. Recheck monthly, and remove an entry once it works again or the source stops publishing it.
